sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/371 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 371, grids 533 and 534 and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sample sites on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; grids for 2026-11-17 to 2027-04-27; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Electric site $37 a night; the sites sold as full hookup $50. The same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $33, full-hookup sites included. The $27 non-electric sites ($23 off-peak) are tent sites, so they don't set the base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Campsite Full Hookup 50.00, Campsite Non-Electric 27.00 with IsRVSite false, no pad, 20' x 20' campsite size; Fee 6.50); sites 045, 001, 054 on Sat 2027-06-19 and on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 (33.00, 33.00, 23.00), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/punderson-state-park-campground ('137 Electric sites (50-amp)'; '20 Full Hookup sites with 20/30/50-amp electric, water and sewer.') + ReserveOhio details (Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on sites 1-18, 20 and 22), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 136 web-listed RV sites, all back-in, pads 25-65 ft (97 electric, 39 sold as full hookup); ODNR counts 137 electric and 20 full hookup. Every RV pad takes a 23-ft rig. The 15 hill sites without electric are tent sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and details (RV types: 97 Campsite Electric, 39 Campsite Full Hookup, PullInTypeName Back In, Pad Length 25-65; Campsite Non-Electric IsRVSite false) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/punderson-state-park-campground ('15 Non-electric sites, hill sites'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: The camp office rents kayaks, canoes, paddleboards and bicycles and loans games; canoe/kayak launch near it.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/punderson-state-park-campground ('Showerhouses, flush toilets, and dump station'; 'Camp office rents kayaks...') + park page ('Bait for sale at the camp store') + ReserveOhio details ('Distance to Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Water and sewer are off in the winter season, beginning October 31. Sites 91-201 are blocked November to about April; sites 1-90 are sold through the winter.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/punderson-state-park-campground ('Water and sewer are not available during winter season (beginning Oct. 31)') + ReserveOhio search/grid (533 sold 2026-11-17 to 2027-03-16; 534 all blocked to 2027-03-16, open 2027-04-13), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservations required for all sites, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

summary: Base changed $27 -> $37: the $27 non-electric sites are tent sites (IsRVSite false, no pad, 20x20), so the cheapest RV night is the $37 electric site; surcharge full_hookup $13 kept, electric add-on dropped; added the $33 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp/W/S, 136 back-in RV sites to 65 ft, showers/flush/water/dump/store, year-round with winter limits, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Pin fine (197 m from centroid). Lakeview confirmed. Weekend minimum not stated on the page (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (440) 564-1195 (camp office/camp store). Park office (440) 564-2279, 8am-5pm Monday-Friday.

ReserveOhio sells 39 sites at the $50 'Campsite Full Hookup' price but only sites 1-18, 20 and 22 list water and sewer hookups (ODNR: '20 Full Hookup sites'). Sites 19, 21, 23-27, 29, 31-41 are typed and priced the same with no water or sewer amenity listed. Unclear whether the engine's listing is incomplete or those are electric sites at the higher price.
